consumer.guide_title: Consumer Packaging Guide: What to Check
consumer.guide_subtitle: Key mandatory statutory declarations required on pre-packaged commodities under the Legal Metrology Act & Rules
consumer.guide_1_desc: Must be clearly stated as "MRP Rs. XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)". Unit sale price per gram/ml is mandatory for multi-unit items.
consumer.guide_2_desc: Must use standard SI units (g, kg, ml, L). Minimum font size is prescribed by law based on package volume/weight.
consumer.guide_3_desc: Complete business name and full physical address. Imported items must state country of origin and importer details.
consumer.guide_4_desc: Month & Year of manufacture or packing. Perishable goods and food products must clearly state Expiry or Best Before date.
consumer.guide_5_desc: Grievance redressal contact details: contact person name/designation, full address, phone number, and valid email.
consumer.guide_6_desc: 14-digit FSSAI license number and standard Veg (green dot in green square) / Non-Veg logo on all food commodities.
consumer.no_screenings_desc: Check your first packaged product with MetrCheck AI to inspect its statutory declarations.
